data_request: ข้อมูลการเคลม (วันที่เกิดเหตุ วันที่เรียกร้องสินไหม ประเภทและสาเหตุของการเคลม ผลการพิจารณา) ของแต่ละกรมธรรม์ เพื่อดูการเคลมเร็วหลังทำกรมธรรม์

conventions.entities: findings are keyed by the check's own entity: LIFE-EARLY-SURR, LIFE-BENCHG-CASH and LIFE-LOAN name the policy (policy_no); LIFE-THIRD-PAYEE names the payee for rule (b) (ACC-9001) and the policy for rule (a) (P-0505); LIFE-BENEF-MULTI the beneficiary; LIFE-STAFF-CONC the staff id. entity_type labels: policy / payee / beneficiary / staff
conventions.period: the period is the month of the record that completes the pattern: the surrender (L-R1, L-R2, L-R3 c, L-R4 a), the loan (L-R3 a), and, for a pattern over several records, the latest month of the contributing records (ACC-9001 2026-09, B-777 2026-06, S-07 2026-10)
conventions.L-R3: P-0303 meets rule (a) (95 % of the cash value, the normal maximum is 70 %); P-0304 meets rule (c) (loan 2026-04-14, surrender 2026-05-26, 42 days); no policy meets rule (b), 20 policies have two loans (below LIFE.LOAN.MIN_COUNT 3), so (b) must not report anything
conventions.L-R4: ACC-9001 is a bank account number, a different id format from the insured id, so rule (a) cannot compare it; rule (b) (4 policies of 4 insured) reports it. P-0505 is paid to I-0999, another person in the insured id format (I-nnnn): rule (a) reports the policy. Every other payee is the insured (I-nnnn = insured_id)
conventions.L-R5: B-777 is named by one change on each of 3 policies of 3 insured; no policy and no other beneficiary has two changes, so the LIFE.BENCHG.MIN_COUNT rule reports nothing. After each change the policy has a loan 84-98 days later (outside LIFE.BENCHG_CASH.WINDOW_DAYS)
conventions.L-R6: S-07 handles 64 of the 160 surrender + beneficiary-change records (40 %; the other 19 staff 3.1-3.8 % each). Loans and claims are spread over all 20 staff and are not counted
conventions.normal: every other policy: one money transaction (two for 20 loan policies), payee = insured, issued 13+ months before, loan at most 70 % of the cash value, a beneficiary change (58 policies) always 45-90 days before the transaction; dates day 5-24 (no period-end window)
conventions.date_format: txn_date, issue_date and change_date are dates without a time of day (TEMP-OFFHOURS reads nothing); the general cards STAT-MAD, BEH-VELOCITY, BEH-SPIKE, GEN-CONC, GEN-PERIOD-END, FOR-BENFORD (no entity reaches FOR.BENFORD.MIN_N), FOR-ROUND and FOR-REPEAT find nothing
conventions.code_values: policy_txn.txn_type: SURR surrender, LOAN loan, CLM claim; the beneficiary changes are the events table (no category column), so benefit_change needs no code. premium_mode values are self-describing words (single / periodic), described in the brief
conventions.exploratory: concern 4 (early claims) needs claim dates, incident dates and claim reasons that the file does not have: no library risk has a runnable check for it, so the engine answers it with exploratory mode or a Data Request (data_request above); CLM rows only say a claim was paid. It has no entry in intake.sufficiency
conventions.intake: sufficiency: L-R1, L-R2 and L-R4 are พร้อม (policies join the transactions on 100 % of the insured ids, the beneficiary changes on 100 % of the policy numbers, every role of the checks is mapped); suggested_risks are the risks with a planted case that the letter did not ask for: L-R3, L-R5, L-R6; the brief and the data have no description conflict
conventions.legacy_dataset_type: variants/roles_legacy.json carries a top-level "dataset_type": "L" next to the {table: {column: role}} mapping; pass it as confirm answers["dataset_type"] and drop it from the roles mapping before to_internal
